archive_identity.variant: First symbol explicitly named in the archive, ETH_Usdt

method.archive_scope: The saved exchange metadata is a placeholder, while ETH is the first explicit symbol in the archived list. The last and sole main routine uses a single injected exchange. This is an ETH named variant of the unchanged archived rule. Other explicitly listed symbols are outside this evidence.
method.position_abi: The native Ethereum fixture confirms independent simultaneous long and short positions. It reports a long first whenever both exist, regardless of submission order or which side reopened. The authored comma expressions open both books while flat, plus a third 0.5 ETH leg selected by seeded RNG. The original source subsequently manages only its first returned position.
method.market_data: Two cold-start four-hour windows in May and June 2021. Recorded public normalized top-five Binance ETH order books and separate BBO projection agree in all 144,002 replay grid points. The May capture contained an indicative funding rate that differs from the final Binance archived settlement. Cash uses the archived settlement rate. Both observed boundary marks agree with nearby checksummed venue mark candles.
method.fills: Each market order uses displayed ETH bid or ask depth known at the call completion time. Use independent per-snapshot side and price capacity, with prior consumption tracked. The source covers 20x leverage and observed 200ms position/order calls. Benchmark fee is 0.04% taker. The sensitivity adds 200ms to each order and executes a complete causal replay.
method.settlement: Keep separate average entry, gross exposure, fees and signed funding for long and short. P&L triggers use captured last trade. Equity and marked drawdown use captured mark prices. Apply funding using the exact venue settlement epoch followed by the first 200ms grid point. Prespecified seeds and antithetic complements keep both sides represented.
method.limitations: Observed liquidity is replayed as fixed. Price impact, hidden size and actual queue executions remain outside this model. Results use two historical dates and repeated seeded paths. Closed returns can differ from total returns while either side stays open.
